description: This file contains utility functions for error handling, URL parameter processing, configuration management, and API interactions within a web application, specifically related to embedding and routing logic.

methods.name: getErrorString
methods.description: Generates an error message string based on error code and message.

methods.name: fromEntriesWithDuplicateKeys
methods.description: Creates an object from URL search parameters, allowing duplicate keys by aggregating values into arrays.

methods.name: isParamValuePresentInUrlSearchParams
methods.description: Checks if a specific parameter with given value(s) exists in URL search parameters.

methods.name: getConfigProp
methods.description: Retrieves a known configuration property value from a config object.

methods.name: getQueryParamProvidedByConfig
methods.description: Gets a configuration-related query parameter value from the current URL.

methods.name: generateDataAttributes
methods.description: Creates a string of HTML data attributes from a key-value object.

methods.name: isRouterPath
methods.description: Determines if a given URL path corresponds to the router path.

methods.name: submitResponseAndGetRoutingResult
methods.description: Sends a POST request to a headless router API and processes the routing result.

methods.name: isSameBookingLink
methods.description: Compares two booking link paths, ignoring '/team/' prefix.

methods.name: buildSearchParamsFromConfig
methods.description: Constructs URL search parameters from a configuration object.

methods.name: buildConfigWithPrerenderRelatedFields
methods.description: Modifies a config object to include prerender-related fields based on context.
